subject: Soy Sauce in Japan Contains Wheat

media.alt_text: Graphic tip card warning that standard Japanese soy sauce contains wheat

caption.body:
Something that surprised me in Japan: standard soy sauce contains wheat. It's in everything — sashimi dipping sauce, ramen broth, yakitori glaze, even rice seasonings sometimes.

I brought GF tamari packets from home (the small single-serve ones) to use instead of whatever soy sauce was on the table.

If you're celiac and traveling to Japan, pack your own tamari.
